value: **AI & Foundation Models**: Investigates foundational text generation and large language model architectures to examine AI literacy, model transparency, and learner interactions. Evidence: "This pilot study investigates the impact of an intervention aimed at demystifying foundational text generation models to enhance AI literacy among ninth-grade English Language Arts students."
